title: Ladki Bahin Scheme: Maharashtra spent  ₹9,605 crore on 9.2 million ineligible beneficiaries, reveals RTI
content:
• Maharashtra spent ₹9,605 crore on 9.2 million ineligible beneficiaries of the Ladki Bahin Yojana until June 2026, as revealed by an RTI.
• The Maharashtra government will recover funds only from 450,000 ineligible beneficiaries who were government employees/officers, not from other categories of ineligible beneficiaries.
• The 'Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana' was launched in August 2024, promising ₹1,500 per month via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to eligible women aged 21 to 65 years.

title: Rain deficit inches up even as Bay prepares to host fresh ‘low’
content:
• India recorded a rain deficit of 15.2 per cent for August until Friday, with the South Peninsula experiencing the highest deficit at 23.1 per cent.
• The all-India rain deficit for the monsoon season from June to August has reached 13.2 per cent.
• The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a watch for a fresh low-pressure area forming as early as Sunday off the West Bengal–Bangladesh coasts and also sounded a fishermen’s alert for the Arabian Sea and Bay of Bengal.
